title: Split MoeProjectService.kt into WS client + daemon supervisor
description: moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/services/MoeProjectService.kt is 1700+ lines mixing WebSocket client/reconnect, daemon spawn/supervision, and board state fan-out. Extract at least the daemon process management into its own class. JetBrains is the primary IDE — keep runIde smoke-tested.
definitionOfDone: daemon spawn/kill logic in a dedicated class with its own unit tests
